orrery.name: brass orrery
orrery.examine: A clockwork model of the heavens — but the socket for Saturn's ring sits empty.

star_chart.name: star-chart
star_chart.examine: Faded constellations, and a margin note: 'The ring completes the dance; the dance opens the brass.'
star_chart.read: 'The ring completes the dance; the dance opens the brass.'

globe.name: celestial globe
globe.examine: A heavy globe of the night sky. Something small seems lodged in a crater.

saturn_ring.name: Saturn-ring
saturn_ring.examine: A delicate golden ring, sized for an orrery's Saturn.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.examine: A heavy brass key, warm to the touch.

cabinet.name: locked cabinet
cabinet.examine: A small iron cabinet. Locked. It rattles when the raven caws.

fig.name: sugared fig
fig.examine: A sticky sweet fig. Ravens adore these.

star_orb.name: Star-Orb
star_orb.examine: A sphere of trapped starlight. The prize.

raven.name: the raven familiar
raven.talk: The raven fixes you with a beady eye and rasps: 'The ring rolled into the globe. The dance opens the brass.'

fig.event: The raven gulps the fig and croaks happily: 'Brass opens the stars. Mind the eastern door.' Then it preens, content.

last_events: It reads: 'The ring completes the dance; the dance opens the brass.'

post_move_context.title: The Astronomer's Tower
post_move_context.goal: Open the locked Observatory and claim the Star-Orb.
